text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (—By their very nature, stars are...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Even when it isn't night, it's always up 
there above us. ...We just can't see it 
with our eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(That day, you vanished from within me, 
and I haven't felt your presence ever 
since.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Whether I run in a race, or look up at 
the stars. I can no longer feel your 
presence like I used to, ...and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I can't feel it, if it's true 
you've been watching over me all along, 
just like stars shining hidden in the 
light...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Or even if you aren't anywhere to be 
found.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm running because *I* want to show you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's you... and there's one other 
person I want watching me, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Today is the Japan Cup, you see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So――yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I guess I'll just go become the 'World's 
Best Big Sister' or something."

The morning of the Japan Cup. Tokyo 
Racecourse was enveloped in a solemn, 
tense atmosphere.

Admire Vega, walking beside me with her 
head held high amidst the crowd, suddenly 
stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Um.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Do you mind if I go talk to those girls 
for a moment?

Looking ahead—ah, there they were, just 
the girls I expected.

Seeing that she could say that on her own 
without any prompting, I smiled back at 
her.
choice_data_list:
Go on ahead. I'll be waiting in the 
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Yes. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O Tokyo, the promised land! Is the wind 
blowing across the turf sparkling, and are 
the hearts of the gathered masses 
trembling?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today is an anniversary to be passed down 
through history. The day the Overlord—nay.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...As the coronation day of the 
"End-of-Century Overlord"!! Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... M-M-Me, m-me, me too...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-T... The crown!! I'll aim for it... 
Y-Yes, I'm going after it!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, you don't say!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Good morning, you two.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there—! Well, well, well, well, if it 
isn't Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Visiting us right before the battle... May 
I take that to mean there are feelings you 
wish to share with us?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As destined rivals painting a 
brilliant era together!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I've told you time and time again, I 
will never set foot on a stage created by 
you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I just have one thing to say to the 
stage's reigning Overlord and her rival, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my own purpose. For the 
dream I wish to fulfill—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't surrender the first-magnitude 
star.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —That's all. See ya.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hold it! I won't let you sing and run. I 
will play out my stage to the very end.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I cannot simply ignore the term 
'first-magnitude star'! For only the 
presence that shines the brightest on 
stage and captures the hearts of the 
audience most can truly be called—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Because they are called top stars.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I can't just hand over that throne!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Then come at me.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Seeking glory, the world's finest gather 
at Fuchu! The Japan Cup is finally about 
to begin!!
(WOOOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What incredible excitement...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Her legs are trembling a bit. 
...She must be terrified.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I felt like... if I looked, I'd realize 
it. I was afraid of having it shoved in my 
face that I can never climb back up there 
again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Still—...!!
